description: Canonical OpenObserve browser-logs stream (@openobserve/browser-logs). No per-service/per-environment/custom log stream is ever created — see docs/openobserve-stream-schema-lifecycle.md.
notes: data_retention:7 and max_query_range:168 are lab-only desired values, verified writable/readable against the pinned OpenObserve v0.91.0 API (see docs/openobserve-v0.91-stream-capabilities.md, capability #7/#8/#9). They are NOT a production default — production retention is an explicit open company decision (REQUIRED_COMPANY_DECISION) and must never be auto-applied outside this lab.

store_original_data stays false: enabling it exposes a raw, un-sanitized pre-flatten '_original' column that bypasses the Stage 9 sanitization pipeline's field-level redaction (verified — see capability #10). Any drift to true on this stream is SECURITY_DRIFT.

full_text_search_keys/index_fields/bloom_filter_fields/partition_keys/distinct_value_fields are all left at the server default (empty/off) pending a real Stage 10 query-profile measurement — see docs/openobserve-stream-schema-lifecycle.md#index-and-partition-decision. No custom index/partition is applied without measured benefit.
